definitions.name: L3A.STEPS
definitions.body: '[' '(' REPLACE ']' ')' REPLACE CHARS [ 'BC' BIND 1 -1 BC '(' EQ SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String -> Vector of +1 per opening and -1 per closing bracket

definitions.name: L3A.RED1
definitions.body: '()' '' REPLACE '[]' '' REPLACE
definitions.note: one round of deleting adjacent matched pairs () and []

definitions.name: L3A.REDUCE
definitions.body: L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1 L3A.RED1
definitions.note: bracket String (<=12 chars) -> what remains after deleting matched pairs until none is left

definitions.name: L3A.BPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS 'PC' BIND 0 PC LENGTH RANGE [ 'PK' BIND PC PK TAKE JOIN L3A.REDUCE '' EQ ] FILTER 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of its longest balanced prefix

definitions.name: L3A.BYNAME
definitions.body: 'LE' BIND LE [ 0 GET ] MAP LE [ 1 GET ] MAP GROUP 'LG' BIND LG KEYS LG VALUES [ L2B.SUM ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: Vector of [ key amount ] pairs -> Record key to summed amount, first-appearance order

definitions.name: L3A.ARGMAX
definitions.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> index of its largest element, first on ties

definitions.name: L3A.ARGMAXKEY
definitions.body: 'AK' BIND AK KEYS AK VALUES L3A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Record of numbers -> key holding the largest value, first on ties

definitions.name: L3A.DEBTORS
definitions.body: L3A.BYNAME 'DR' BIND DR KEYS [ 'DK' BIND DR DK GET 0 LT ] FILTER
definitions.note: ledger of [ name amount ] -> names whose total is negative, first-appearance order

definitions.name: L3A.LARGEST
definitions.body: 'LQ' BIND LQ LQ [ 1 GET ] MAP L3A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] -> entry with the largest amount, first on ties

definitions.name: L3A.UNWORDS
definitions.body: [ 'UW' BIND ' ' UW 2 COLLECT JOIN ] MAP JOIN TRIM
definitions.note: Vector of space-free words -> one String joined by single spaces

definitions.name: L3A.CAP
definitions.body: LOWER CHARS 'KC' BIND KC 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER KC 1 DROP JOIN 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: non-empty word -> first letter upper case, rest lower case

definitions.name: L3A.RLE
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV RV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT [ 'RX' BIND 'RA' BIND RA -1 GET 'RL' BIND RA -1 DROP RX RL 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT RA RX 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 RL 0 GET RX EQ SELECT GET ] FOLD
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> run-length encoding as [ value count ] pairs

definitions.name: L3A.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'UV' BIND UV UV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'UX' BIND 'UA' BIND UX UA 1 GET 1 ADD 1 UX UA 0 GET GT SELECT 2 COLLECT ] SCAN [ 1 GET ] MAP G0C.MAXV
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> length of longest strictly increasing adjacent stretch

definitions.name: L3A.MAJ
definitions.body: 'MV' BIND MV TALLY 'MT' BIND MT KEYS MT VALUES L3A.ARGMAX GET NIL 2 COLLECT 0 1 MT VALUES G0C.MAXV 2 MUL MV LENGTH GT SELECT GET
definitions.note: non-empty Vector -> value filling more than half the positions, or NIL

definitions.name: L3A.PRESENT
definitions.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Vector -> its non-NIL elements

definitions.name: L3A.MISSMASK
definitions.body: [ NIL? 'GM' BIND 1 0 GM SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector -> 1 where the element is NIL, 0 elsewhere

definitions.name: L3A.GAPS
definitions.body: L3A.MISSMASK 'GK' BIND GK 1 [ 0 ] GK CONCAT -1 DROP SUB MUL L2B.SUM
definitions.note: Vector with NILs -> number of runs of consecutive NILs

definitions.name: L3A.FILLED
definitions.body: 'FV' BIND FV FV L3A.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'FX' BIND 'FA' BIND FA FX FX NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: readings with NILs -> forward-filled, leading NILs take the first present reading

definitions.name: L3A.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'RV' BIND RV RV 0 GET 0 2 COLLECT [ 'RX' BIND 'RA' BIND RA 0 GET 'RP' BIND RX NIL 1 RX RX NIL? SELECT 1 RP RP NIL? SELECT DIV 2 COLLECT 0 1 RX NIL? NOT RP NIL? NOT AND NOT SELECT GET 2 COLLECT ] SCAN 1 DROP [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: readings with NILs -> each over the one before (n-1 long), NIL where either is missing

definitions.name: L3A.SCALED
definitions.body: 'SV' BIND SV L3A.PRESENT G0C.MAXV 'SM' BIND SV [ 'SX' BIND NIL 1 SX SX NIL? SELECT SM DIV 2 COLLECT 0 1 SX NIL? SELECT GET ] MAP
definitions.note: readings with NILs -> each present reading over the largest present one, NIL kept

definitions.name: L3A.MEDIAN
definitions.body: 'MS' BIND MS SORT 'MZ' BIND MZ MS LENGTH 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET MZ MS LENGTH 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> median

definitions.name: L3A.ABS
definitions.body: 'AB' BIND AB AB -1 MUL MAX
definitions.note: absolute value; lifts over a Vector

definitions.name: L3A.MAD
definitions.body: 'DV' BIND DV DV L3A.MEDIAN SUB L3A.ABS L3A.MEDIAN
definitions.note: non-empty numeric Vector -> median absolute deviation from the median

definitions.name: L3A.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'WV' BIND WV -2 DROP WV 1 DROP -1 DROP ADD WV 2 DROP ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: numeric Vector of length >= 3 -> means of each three consecutive numbers
